Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on m

args.body:
src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the public application URL from the configuration or environment variables rather than falling back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is unset, ensuring password reset emails contain production-correct links.
args.title: Use configured public URL for password reset email links instead of localhost
